entry.title: πClideaN MPC 1.3.1
entry.summary: # Version 1.3.1 - Add per-step GATE locks using the existing upper-right control in EDIT. LINE GATE remains the default; steps without a lock inherit it. - Keep HOLD priority and apply the effective GATE duration to each ratchet repeat. A short or One Shot sample may not reveal MIDI note-length changes; use a target that responds to Note Off. - Highlight the entire expression-control box in purple when the selected step has a lock: GATE, velocity, probability, ratchet and decay. - Limit patterns
